rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the creation of a high-level `Pipeline` facade class in `gbad_core/pipeline.py`. This class will orchestrate the entire conversion process and provide a simple interface for users and developers.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote: **Context:** The refactored components need to be brought together into a single, easy-to-use pipeline. The `Pipeline` facade will serve as the main entry point for the library.
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `Pipeline` Class in `gbad_core/pipeline.py`:** - The `__init__` method will take a configuration object. - It will instantiate all the necessary components (`DrawIOParser`, `CSVPreprocessor`, `RMLGenerator`, `RMLMapper`, `Postprocessor`, `GraphMerger`) and store them as instance variables. 2. **Implement `run()` Method:** - This method will take a list of Draw.io file paths and a list of CSV file paths. - It will read the content of the files. - It will then call the methods of the instantiated components in the correct order to execute the full pipeline. - It will return the final, merged `rdflib.Dataset`.
